name: Prijsvrij Travel Holding
note: Holding that since 2021 groups Prijsvrij Vakanties together with D-reizen. Prijsvrij Vakanties was founded in 2010 by ICT entrepreneur Marc van Deursen; in 2014 DER Touristik (part of REWE Group) took a 50 percent stake in the company. Headquarters in 's-Hertogenbosch.
